newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says no room for complacency on c/a.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says no room for complacency on c/a.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday that Australia's current account outcome for September underlined the need to boost national savings and meant there was no room for complacency.
Australia's seasonally-adjusted current account deficit widened to A$1.690 billion in September from A$1.470 billion in August (revised from A$1.33 billion).
Economists had on average forecast a seasonally-adjusted September current account deficit of about A$1.30 billion.
"The legacy of excessive current account deficits left by the previous government reflects the decline in Australia's national savings," Costello said in a statement.
"Savings must be addressed to address the underlying cause of this problem," he said.
